messages:
samantha_support: FYI - customer (ACME Corp) opened a support ticket: Node/TS SDK v0.18.1 suddenly returning 404 for chat route after they updated. Error: \"404 Not Found: /v1/chat/generate\". They pasted minimal repro below.

samantha_support: Repro steps we asked for:
```js
// npm install @redwood/inference@0.18.1
const client = new RedwoodClient();
await client.chat.generate({ model: 'redwood-2', input: 'Summarize the Q2 results' });
// -> 404 Not Found /v1/chat/generate
```

samantha_support: Customer says it worked yesterday and broke after running `npm ci` this morning. They need a workaround ASAP, paying customers impacted.

olivia_se: Thanks @samantha_support. Can you confirm the exact SDK package name they installed and the full package-lock? Also whether they're behind any proxy or using a custom baseURL?

jordan_dev: Quick heads-up — we shipped a server-side route rename last week (chat.generate -> chat.create) while the Node SDK should have a compatibility shim. Possibly the published shim didn't include the param mapping for `input` -> `messages`.

ramon_sdk: Investigating — looking at the v0.18.1 client code in the registry: the shim map for chat route exists but only for JS consumers with ESM import path. CommonJS path missed the export, so the client falls back to direct fetch to `/v1/chat/generate`. That endpoint was removed server-side.

samantha_support: Can we give the customer a short-term patch they can apply? They can't wait for a full release.

ramon_sdk: Workaround for their app: call the REST endpoint directly (bypass SDK) or use the new method name if they import the ESM entrypoint. Example minimal fix:
```js
// temporary: direct REST call
const res = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL + '/v1/chat/create', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-2', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the Q2 results' }] })
});
```

ramon_sdk: Will open a hotfix release (v0.18.2) to patch the CommonJS export and add param aliasing (`input` -> `messages`) so older code paths keep working. PR #452.

engops-bot: deploy-bot: Notifying CI to run release pipeline for @redwood/inference v0.18.2 — build queued.

product_ana: Customer impact: 3 paying seats, 2 production apps down. Recommend we prioritize backport and an email to affected customers once release is staged.

jordan_dev: Agreed. Ramon, please link the PR and the interim repro steps in the support ticket. Ops: if build passes, let's cut the patch and publish to npm. Support will send the workaround and ETA.

ramon_sdk: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/452 — adds CJS export fix + param aliasing + unit tests. ETA after CI: ~30-45m.

samantha_support: Thanks team — sent interim workaround to customer and marked ticket as high priority. I'll update once patch is published. :thumbsup:

ramon_sdk: Patch published to npm v0.18.2 — please confirm if ACME still sees 404 after upgrading.

samantha_support: Confirmed with ACME: upgrade to @redwood/inference@0.18.2 fixed the 404. They also had to rename `input` to `messages` in some internal helpers; the alias kept things working for most calls. Closing as resolved after customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
